name: b03 — §170 rupee rounding applied once, on the raw total
workings: Two exempt consultation lines with netPaise 5651 and 5582 — a pair chosen BECAUSE it discriminates. rawTotal = 5651 + 5582 = 11233; roundTotalToRupee(11233) = divHalfUp(11233, 100) x 100 = floor((22,466 + 100) / 200) x 100 = floor(112.83) x 100 = 11200, rounding 11200 - 11233 = -33. Rounding each line first would give roundTotalToRupee(5651) = floor((11,302 + 100) / 200) x 100 = floor(57.01) x 100 = 5700 and roundTotalToRupee(5582) = floor((11,164 + 100) / 200) x 100 = floor(56.32) x 100 = 5600, summing to 11300 (mutant M-B03). The plan's first candidate pair 5617 / 5616 rounds to 5600 + 5600 = 11200 under BOTH implementations and proves nothing — self-review item 3; do not simplify this pair back.
